caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, light blue glass vessel centered on a plain, cream-colored background. The vessel has a wide, rounded body and a long, narrow neck that flares slightly at the top opening. The glass shows highlights and reflections in soft pink and white tones, indicating its glossy surface. At the lower part of the rounded body, there are three small protruding nozzles or outlets, each rendered in blue-gray tones. The overall composition is minimal, with the vessel being the only object, isolated against the empty background.
title: Vase
